summaryForNext: Assessment written and adversarially vetted (final PASS 0C/4W; round 0 was BLOCK 2C/3W, fixed by attaching evidence; independence caveat: tool reports cross_model_check unverified-producer-unknown). Key gaps: no A2UI renderer or AG-UI render registry exists client-side; UAR speaks A2UI v0.9.1 but only accepts nine components and two catalog ids, never negotiates a client catalog, and the site proxy strips A2UI request fields; PEM @prometheus-ags/a2ui-react is the best base but pins official 0.10.2 and breaks on 0.12.0 (5 type errors, 14/30 tests); the public stream leaks provider_event and attempt_manifest. WARNINGs carried: PEM publish ability untested; Basic Catalog custom-element bundle cost unmeasured. Open questions for plan: scope of 'complete UAR integration' (whole 36 changes vs A2UI critical path), A2UI on the public agent or app only, UAR validator changes, PEM publisher, leak fix timing, register PEM as writable.
